steps: Tap the Druid for green mana.
Untap it by putting a -1/-1 counter on it. The Vizier shaves that counter off, every time.
The Druid never shrinks. Repeat as long as you like.
swap: No Ballista? Any X spell that only wants green and generic will do. Infinite mana needs one place to go.
